data.name: Ijliyah
data.gender_notes: Ijliyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ijliyah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'j-l-y' which means 'gentle' or 'soft'. It symbolizes the delicate beauty and fragility of nature, reminding us of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) saying, 'Allah is gentle and loves gentleness.'. The name Ijliyah carries the meaning “Gentle flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ijliyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ijliyah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
